technical_batch_policy: Match actual non-targeting controls by the two GEM-X Flex v2 lanes L1/L2. The 24 indexed aliquots are random splits of the same K562 culture, not independent biological contexts. Keep original aliquot labels for audit.
control_limit: 69 total NTCs and three CTRL guides; no duplication across source bins, no synthetic control cells, no independent-family support vote.
paper_evidence_paraphrase: The genome-wide screen split one transduced K562 culture into 24 indexed aliquots and processed them across two Flex v2 lanes.
source_q_policy: Matched-lane per-cell CPM means, delta-method SE with .05 floor, source normal-q proxies only; uncertainty of sparse lane controls retained.
